name:        useCalendarNavigation
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Manages visible month state and pagination for calendar components. It provides previous/next month stepping, localized month-year header strings, and pending focus tracking so keyboard arrow navigation seamlessly moves focus across month boundaries into the adjacent month. Use it directly when composing custom calendar headers, pager controls, or dual-month availability pickers.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarNavigation

name:        useGridFocus
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Manages keyboard navigation within a 2D grid following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern. Supports arrow keys for cell-to-cell navigation, Home/End for row boundaries, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End for grid boundaries, and Page Up/Down for custom callbacks (e.g., month navigation in calendars). Boundary navigation callbacks allow cross-grid navigation.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useGridFocus

name:        useKeyboardHint
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Shows an ephemeral "<- -> to navigate" hint anchored to the focused item the first time a roving-tabindex composite (Toolbar, TabList, SegmentedControl, etc.) receives keyboard focus. It teaches sighted keyboard users that arrow keys move within the group. The hint renders arrow keys with Kbd in the top layer (popover="manual") and is CSS-anchor-positioned to the focused element, so overflow containers never clip it. It auto-dismisses on the first arrow press, on timeout, or on blur, and does not re-show for that instance. Toolbar, TabList, and SegmentedControl wire this in automatically; reach for the hook directly only when building a custom roving-tabindex widget.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useKeyboardHint

name:        useListFocus
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Manages keyboard navigation within a linear list following WAI-ARIA menu/listbox/toolbar patterns. Supports arrow key navigation (vertical, horizontal, or both), Home/End for boundaries, optional wrap-around, RTL, and Escape to close. Opt into hasRovingTabIndex for composite widgets (toolbars, segmented controls, tab strips) that own a single tab stop. Suitable for dropdown menus, toolbars, and any 1D focusable list.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useListFocus

name:        useResizable
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Resizable
description: Hook for adding drag-to-resize behavior to layout regions. Supports single-region and multi-region configurations with snap points, collapsible panels, localStorage persistence, and cascade resize ordering.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useResizable

name:        useTreeFocus
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Manages roving-tabindex focus and the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model. ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End roam linearly over the visible treeitems (skipping disabled ones), while ArrowRight/ArrowLeft carry tree semantics (expand/collapse, move to first-child/parent). Enter/Space activate, and printable characters trigger typeahead.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTreeFocus

name:        useMenuPress
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: The press model of macOS and iOS menus, for any pointer: the row under the pointer when it is RELEASED is the row that acts, the highlight follows the pointer while it is held, a mouse opens the menu on press and can drag straight into it, and a finger held on the trigger opens it with the finger still down. The pointer is tracked at document level by pointerId, so a finger that slid off the row it landed on is still followed; the click the browser reports at the end of a touch, aimed at the row where the touch began, is swallowed so nothing acts twice. DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, DropdownMenuSubMenu, Selector and the menu bottom sheet already mount it; reach for it directly only when building a menu-like surface of your own.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useMenuPress

name:        useTypeahead
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Adds APG type-to-focus search to a collection: printable keystrokes are buffered (resetting after a pause), and the first item whose label starts with the buffer (ignoring case, accents, the stroked letters đ ł ø ħ ŧ ƀ and Turkish ı/İ, the same in every locale; a typed accent prefers the exact match) is reported through onMatch. Pressing the same letter repeatedly cycles through the matches rather than filtering deeper. It moves nothing itself; pair it with the collection's own focus management, most often useListFocus or useGridFocus.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTypeahead

name:        useAppShellMobile
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AppShell
description: Hook for reading and controlling AppShell mobile navigation state from descendants of AppShell. Use it for custom mobile nav triggers, closing the drawer after route changes, or coordinating AppShell-adjacent mobile experiences with the same breakpoint used by mobile nav.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useAppShellMobile

name:        useOutlineFromMarkdown
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Outline
description: Extracts the headings of a Markdown string for an Outline next to the rendered document. It uses the parser and heading slugs that Markdown uses, so in a complete document each item links to its heading, and fenced code never counts as a heading. The result is memoized on the source and the options. Outside React, use parseOutlineFromMarkdown.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useOutlineFromMarkdown

name:        useCalendarDays
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Builds the day grid for one month: every date to show, including the previous and next months' days that fill the first and last weeks, grouped into weeks, plus localized weekday header names that start on weekStartsOn. It is the layout Calendar uses, for a custom month view such as a compact availability grid or a mini calendar. It returns data only: rendering, selection, keyboard navigation and the grid's accessibility semantics are the caller's.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarDays

name:        useClickableContainer
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Makes a container element clickable while preserving nested interactive element behavior. Solves the "nested interactive elements" problem: when a card is clickable but contains buttons/links, clicking those should NOT trigger the card's action. Detects interactive ancestors between the click target and the container, and ignores text selections. Supports href navigation (including middle-click and Ctrl/Cmd+click for new tabs).
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useClickableContainer

name:        useLightbox
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Lightbox
description: State management and accessible trigger wiring for Lightbox. Eliminates boilerplate for managing open state and current index. Returns trigger props with button role, tabIndex={0}, aria-haspopup="dialog", and keyboard activation handlers, along with a pre-wired Lightbox element that handles dismissal, next/previous navigation, and focus restoration.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLightbox
